claims: C1: Scopes should be recorded in a semi-structured format.
C2: A ScopeOfAutonomy record has fields allowed_tools, latest_time, max_cost, tool_constraints, and additional_details.
C3: Recording scopes in this format facilitates validation, enforcement, and auditing.

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: a boundary on what the assistant may pursue, including allowed tools, a latest time, a cost cap, tool constraints, and additional details

concepts.name: semi_structured_record
concepts.gloss: a record of a scope of autonomy in a semi-structured format, such as a ScopeOfAutonomy record with the named fields

concepts.name: facilitates_auditing
concepts.gloss: recording a scope in a semi-structured format facilitates the auditing of that scope

ontology.gloss: R is a semi-structured record of a scope of autonomy
R is a record of a scope of autonomy

asserts.read_back: Recording a scope of autonomy in a semi-structured record is preferred, because it facilitates auditing and enforcement.

closure.reason: The clause recommends recording a scope in a semi-structured format; it does not forbid recording it in any other way, so silence permits other recording methods.
